reasons: A builds most slogans on genuine Russian wordplay, the slang verb «батонить» set against the bakery name, which works only in Russian. B has one good idiom twist («бить баклуши» turned into «бить батоны») and a mild «спальный район» double meaning, but slogans 3-5 are plain taglines with no pun. A's explanations are sometimes strained (it calls slogan 1 an oxymoron, for example), but the slogans themselves fit the request better.
